source: RFC 0014 §3 R1, R2, R6, T (the coordinator's ruling of 2026-11-24 on the cross-version fixture); the red-team inventory, row 3
statement: A refresh token is strict: only a token whose cosec.token is refresh is one, and no version takes it for an access token. A refresh token whose crit names an extension is not read either (IDN-47), by either version.
guards: compat:TokenCompatTest#a refresh token is refused as an access token by every version
compat:TokenCompatTest#a refresh token whose crit names an extension is refused by a version that does not understand it
